entries.topicDescription: Fragment lifecycle, communication, and management within Activities and Navigation.

tips.title: Use the Fragment Result API instead of direct references between Fragments for communication
tips.content:
Having one Fragment hold a direct reference to another (or to its host
Activity cast to a specific interface) tightly couples them and breaks
easily during navigation changes or configuration changes, when Fragment
instances are recreated.

The Fragment Result API lets a Fragment set a result keyed by a request
key, and another Fragment listen for it via the FragmentManager — neither
Fragment needs a direct reference to the other, and it correctly survives
Fragment recreation since it's coordinated through the FragmentManager
rather than a direct object reference.
